problem_context.problem_statement:
# Consumer migration contract

Migrate only the assigned existing C function's specifications/proof-facing definitions to the accepted generic storeA shared model. User requires definitions aligned with crtosverify/master dll.v as directly used by IDNode.store_idnodes, referencing current SLL/DLL operation specifications. Reuse existing definitions and proofs wherever possible; apart from storeA, preserve existing behavior, executable C, node layout, API names, spec labels/variants, sentinel and edge-case semantics. Do not add business-data fields to C list nodes.

Reference snapshots: OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_double_link_common/reports/storeA_migration_reference/dll.v, idnode.v and xs_id.h, commit d215f73b69916cc5c7c01af752bca4b6f96b3530. DLL.storeA has type addr -> A -> Assertion. IdNode embeds uint16 id and DoubleLinklistType link; store_idnode links the inner link address to its outer object's id field. The SLL/DLL common libraries in the round worktree contain the accepted generic payload model from the initial migration. Read and reuse those definitions. DLL uses XiziStoreADLL.DL_Node (constructor data then ptr), dllseg and store_dll, with xizi_store_dll as public alias. SLL uses xizi_sll_head_payload and other payload adapters over existing generic recursions. This SLL length run owns the declared shared case_lib so that reusable payload/structure bridges can be supplied once for subsequent consumers. Preserve all existing definitions and theorem statements and append only needed generic bridges and length specification declarations. Other libraries are read-only.

C contracts must quantify arbitrary A and storeA (not only emp) and preserve associated logical data as well as pointer ordering. Query operations preserve payloads; insertion consumes the new node's payload and inserts the same logical node; deletion returns the removed node's payload alongside the previous detached structural resource, leaving remaining payloads unchanged. Maintain prior not-found, sentinel, null and return-value cases. Do not impose arbitrary extra preconditions to avoid proving previously covered paths. Use pure getPtr projections or simple mathematical list relations to reuse old address-based operation definitions. Do not reimplement the C algorithm in Rocq or discard old spec variants without justification.

The allowed case_lib is the declared common library, the only writable Rocq library for this run. Remove any unused C annotation import of the legacy empty length-specific lib; keep the shared library as the sole active case_lib. New C Extern declarations can live in the target C so existing headers remain untouched. Add only needed mathematical declarations/bridges in annotation, leaving witness proofs for group workers. Existing archived manual proofs and case-local proved lemmas may be used as proof-pattern references, not current acceptance evidence.

Use controller canonical driver settings including -IQCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ and -slp QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ SimpleC.EE.QCP_demos_LLM. Interactive qcp-mcp may be accessed through local mcp/qcp-mcp Python SessionManager if no MCP tools are exposed; record actual driver, cwd, -I and -slp. Coq feedback only through main-worktree coq_tooling.py check/debug. Root AGENTS.md supersedes older skill role/scratch descriptions. Fixed-phase report status/source versions must be placed inside agent_result.annotation or agent_result.vc_checking, not just at agent_result top level.

Before finishing annotation, ensure the case_lib seed imports the separation-logic modules and opens the proof notation scopes needed for anticipated spatial helper lemmas. Group workers may only add official Rocq dependency imports; they cannot later add missing project Require Import lines. For a mathematical-only legacy case_lib, read the existing shared model import conventions and add the necessary project imports/namespace openings in this annotation-owned seed when appropriate. Keep these minimal.

## SLL length and reusable bridges

Migrate SingleLinkListGetLen to arbitrary A/storeA, retaining the exact Zlength result and all existing behavior. Reuse the old loop split invariant on pointer projections with an unchanged payload frame. Never add a list-length input bound to avoid overflow proof: reuse the prior finite-heap cardinality argument, with only architecture adaptations required by the current libraries.

The completed SLL remove_node case has proved generic list/head payload factor/unfactor helpers. Read its active accepted case_lib at SeparationLogic/examples/OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_single_link_remove_node/source/xizi_single_link_remove_node_lib.v in the round snapshot. Promote/reuse only the general payload definitions and factor/unfactor proof bodies into the declared common case_lib, keeping names and definitions consistent with the accepted ones wherever possible. Do not import the removal library into common. Removal-specific relation, first-occurrence and member facts stay case-local. Add segment factor/unfactor only if needed, reusing the existing generic_sllseg structure. This is the single common bridge adoption run; preserve all existing common definitions and theorem statements and record provenance.

The archived old length manual is a proof-pattern reference. Annotation supplies the seed definitions and general reused proofs, leaving generated witnesses to group workers. Any private legacy empty length library import should be removed from C annotation if unused, keeping common as the sole active case_lib.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Arbitrary A/storeA, exact Zlength, same payloads and ordering, unchanged C; reuse accepted SLL removal payload factor/unfactor proofs once in the common case_lib and the old finite-heap proof; no extra input length bound.
